original_card.question: Can one exact all-size/compiler, precision, hosting or restoration implication be proved or falsified?
methods: Prove one missing implication with explicit quantified hypotheses.
Find an exact counterexample at the claimed interface boundary.
original_card.acceptance_gate: Identify the proposition and what would change downstream; do not equate a finite replay with a universal proof.

first_step.inspect: Read the selected review scope and choose one exact all-size or precision implication.
first_step.scope: Positive control / source-bound orientation only; this is not a new construction or full cold replay.

original_card.first_experiment: Write its quantified inputs and conclusion; find a missing hypothesis or construct a minimal exact adversarial instance.
original_card.bottleneck_link: Finite supplier improvements are useful only under the retained transfer obligations.
allowed_variations: Choose one tape, precision, hosting or restoration lemma.
scope_change_triggers: Replacing a quantified obligation with another finite smoke test.

actual_scope: Exact deterministic read-once residual-state counts at canonical physical synthetic-twiddle address cuts, including the early extracted low prefix.
scope_change_reason: The current encoded-control handoff leaves address production open. Before another producer construction, quantify exactly which prefix information a one-pass reader must retain. This is a scoped memory theorem, not a new compiler or repeated supplied-program interpreter.
bottleneck_link: A header producer feeds the signed monomial/layer boundary. Exact residual-state counts identify information that a one-pass producer must retain or reread; they do not price a complete consumer or establish a supplier.
stop_rule: Stop at the all-size cut-state formula, source-layout derivation, exhaustive small residual functions, interval/closed-form checks and optimized CLI controls. Do not start a producer construction or claim a kappa gain.
evidence: PROOF.md proves the unbounded formula. RESULT.json records 600 physical cut cases and 593228 complete-address evaluations, 1560 independent modular-sum cases, 1152 exact closed-form cases, eleven boundary rejections and exact large-integer examples. test_controls.py tests eight optimized CLI fault groups and a valid retry.
